summary: Tested granular RBAC #24 follow-ups. Backend: POST /api/roles/granular-suggestion (superadmin 200, non-super 403, unauth 401/403, invalid portal 'maklon' 400, single-portal filter, fallback to PORTAL_ACCESS when portals empty, does NOT persist) and PUT /api/roles/{id} with >500 keys returns all keys (7/7 pytest pass). UI: Kontrol Akses > Peran & Hak Akses tab — accounting: convert-legacy-all-btn 43 -> 247 izin, toast '204 izin per modul ditambahkan (43 modul)', role-dirty-badge appears, role-reset-btn reverts to 43; group-finance-convert-legacy adds 91 keys (18 modul), reset reverts; nothing saved (accounting still 43 keys via API). ModuleActionGuard: created role uji_lihat_saja (finance/self/collaboration) + user, applied group-finance-level-view + Save (19 izin) via UI; as that user 'Mode lihat saja' badge shows on fin-expenses/fin-cash/fin-kasbon/fin-petty-cash/fin-accounting-master-hub; Tambah/Export (exp-add, dtv2-expenses-export), ca-add + row pen/trash icons, Kasbon CSV, CoA 'Tambah Akun'/Edit/Hapus all hidden with data-rbac-hidden='1'; superadmin sees all (0 hidden, no badge). Backend also enforces: POST /api/rahaza/expenses -> 403 with clear message for the view-only user. Test role/user cleaned up.

minor.issue: Raw request.json() without Pydantic model; non-string 'portal' / non-list 'portals' not validated (returns 400 by accident or coerces). Low risk (superadmin only).

ui_bugs.issue: Only scans buttons inside the main content div. Radix Dialog/Sheet/DropdownMenu content is portalled to <body>, and DropdownMenuItem are role=menuitem divs, so Hapus/Edit/Approve in row action menus, detail sheets or dialogs are NOT hidden for view-only users (backend still blocks with 403). Not observed in tested modules but structurally uncovered.

issues: Empty state still says 'Klik "Tambah" untuk input biaya operasional.' while Tambah is hidden
Date filters use native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn calendar (pre-existing)

action_items: Optional: extend ModuleActionGuard to cover portalled overlays (dialogs/sheets/dropdown menuitems) e.g. via a context-aware canDo in shared components, or observe document.body for elements opened from within the guarded module
Optional: hide/adjust empty-state copy referencing 'Tambah' when canDo(create) is false

Optional: consider warning in convert-legacy toast that actions without legacy mapping (delete/approve) are granted fully when the role can open the portal (accounting finance becomes 92/94) — owner should review before saving
critical_code_review_comments: ModuleActionGuard classification is regex-heuristic: buttons like 'Buat Laporan', 'Cetak'/'Unduh' for read-only reports will be hidden for users lacking create/export — intended for export, but /^buat/ could hide non-create actions
suggest_from_legacy grants all unmapped actions when portal access is true — preserves legacy semantics but is very permissive
